title: Peacock eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail feathers fanning behind -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='40' rx='9' ry='22' fill='#2f7d4f' transform='rotate(-35 30 40)'/>
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='40' rx='9' ry='22' fill='#3fa86a' transform='rotate(-20 30 40)'/>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='38' rx='9' ry='24' fill='#2f7d4f' transform='rotate(-5 34 38)'/>
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='38' rx='9' ry='24' fill='#3fa86a' transform='rotate(12 40 38)'/>
    <ellipse cx='48' cy='40' rx='9' ry='22' fill='#2f7d4f' transform='rotate(28 48 40)'/>
    <ellipse cx='55' cy='44' rx='8' ry='19' fill='#3fa86a' transform='rotate(42 55 44)'/>
    <!-- eye spots -->
    <circle cx='24' cy='25' r='4' fill='#f2c230'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='25' r='2' fill='#2b5f8a'/>
    <circle cx='31' cy='20' r='4' fill='#f2c230'/>
    <circle cx='31' cy='20' r='2' fill='#2b5f8a'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='18' r='4' fill='#f2c230'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='18' r='2' fill='#2b5f8a'/>
    <circle cx='49' cy='20' r='4' fill='#f2c230'/>
    <circle cx='49' cy='20' r='2' fill='#2b5f8a'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='26' r='4' fill='#f2c230'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='26' r='2' fill='#2b5f8a'/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='62' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#2b6fc4'/>
  <!-- wing hint -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='64' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#4a95e0'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M74 54 Q82 46 84 38' stroke='#2b6fc4' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='85' cy='35' r='8' fill='#3a86db'/>
  <!-- crest -->
  <line x1='85' y1='27' x2='85' y2='21' stroke='#4a95e0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='19' r='2' fill='#f2c230'/>
  <line x1='89' y1='28' x2='91' y2='22' stroke='#4a95e0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='20' r='2' fill='#f2c230'/>
  <line x1='81' y1='28' x2='79' y2='22' stroke='#4a95e0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='20' r='2' fill='#f2c230'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='34' r='2' fill='#f5f2e6'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='34' r='1' fill='#1b2a3a'/>
  <!-- beak eating a snack -->
  <polygon points='93,36 100,39 93,42' fill='#f0a030'/>
  <!-- snack: little cracker/biscuit -->
  <circle cx='97' cy='45' r='4' fill='#d9853c'/>
  <circle cx='95.5' cy='44' r='0.8' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <circle cx='98.5' cy='44' r='0.8' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <circle cx='97' cy='47' r='0.8' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='56' y1='77' x2='56' y2='90' stroke='#c98a2e' stroke-width='3'/>
  <line x1='67' y1='77' x2='67' y2='90' stroke='#c98a2e' stroke-width='3'/>
  <path d='M52 90 L56 90 L60 90' stroke='#c98a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M63 90 L67 90 L71 90' stroke='#c98a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
</svg>
